SELECT 
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.colour = 'blue' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) - 
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.colour = 'no_eye_color' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS difference

WHERE T1.weight_kg IS NULL OR T1.weight_kg = 0
